basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Software Engineer – Backend (Commerce) · Python & Go · REST APIs · PostgreSQL · 9,300★ OSS Contributor · 3.5+ Years

summaries.se1-commerce: Software Engineer – Backend (Commerce) with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Python, Go, REST APIs, and scalable backend services on PostgreSQL and cloud platforms. Built a Python-based Model Context Protocol server and optimized PostgreSQL queries powering enterprise compliance audits at Turbot HQ, improving query performance 40% while cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90% through backend automation.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a cloud-native SaaS platform; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.

Built a Kafka-based, event-driven pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for reliable failure handling.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff — investigating pod logs and status and collaborating with the platform team to restore service.
